{{Navbar-GlobalBioenergyPowerTracker}}
'''Snetterton power station''' is an operating power station of at least 42-megawatts (MW) in Breckland District, Norfolk, England, United Kingdom.
It is also known as Snetterton Renewable Energy Centre, Snetterton Renewable Energy Plant (Snetterton Biomass Plant).
